turns.content: Three distinguishable atoms each have spin 1/2 and interact through H=(lambda/3)(sigma_1 dot sigma_2+sigma_2 dot sigma_3+sigma_3 dot sigma_1). Before considering energies, what angular-momentum representation problem determines the possible molecular spin multiplets?
Describe a successive-coupling method for decomposing the three-spin Hilbert space into irreducible total-spin sectors, including a dimension check on the result.
Write the spin state space as a tensor product of three spin-1/2 representations and give its total dimension.
First couple particles 1 and 2. Which total-spin representations can this pair form?
Couple the third spin-1/2 particle to each representation from the pair. What is the complete irreducible decomposition?
How many distinct spin-3/2 and spin-1/2 multiplets occur, counting repeated copies of the same representation?
Verify the decomposition by summing the dimensions of all multiplets and comparing the result with the original tensor-product space.

The Hamiltonian is rotationally invariant and can be expressed in terms of total spin. Does this interaction change the representation multiplicities, or only assign energies to the total-spin sectors?
State the final irreducible multiplet content of the three-spin-one-half system.
